1976-2363-4659-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Etherium Sculptor, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4681-5170-7192-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Grave Venerations triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

907-950-2645-3430.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2292-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2292-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4289-6920--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-6920--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Silk triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

4153-4186-6798--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2034-3197-6566--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Yuna triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

2557-4682-5140-7824.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
2557-4682-5140-7824.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Parallel Lives and Bard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
2557-4682-5140-7824.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

2723-5191.description:
Deal damage to Raptor Hatchling.
Raptor Hatchling and Blazing Sunsteel trigger.
Resolve the Raptor Hatchling trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage to Raptor Hatchling.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1879-3132-3259.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1879-3132-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3132-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1003-3661-4973-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-3661-4973-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1409-3099-4927-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7297-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
3259-7297-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7297-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7297-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

1172-1624-5864.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

3490-4455-5330-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
3490-4455-5330-7426.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Ghost Lantern triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat

856-4321-5231-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5231-7422.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

413-1453-4559-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
413-1453-4559-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1274-2086-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

703-2726-6753.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Astral Dragon spell.
Resolve the copy of the Astral Dragon spell, putting one token copy of Astral Dragon onto the battlefield (note this is not "created" so it is not doubled).
When the Astral Dragon token enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, creating four token copies of TOKEN DOUBLER that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the original Astral Dragon spell from step 1.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating 64 token copies of TOKEN DOUBLER that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

2034-6701--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-6701--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a persist creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other persist creature.
Resolve the perist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

56-789-4976-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-789-4976-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Open the Graves and Gutter Grime trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-789-4976-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-2265.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Hardened Scales
Repeat.

1144-3385-4180.description:
Whenever a land enters the battlefield, it enters as a 1/1 Forest creature due to Yavimaya and Living Lands.
Aether Flash triggers, dealing 2 damage to the land.
The land dies as a state-based action due to having less than zero toughness.

2757-3340-3713.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Steelfin Whale, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Steelfin Whale, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.

3073-4918-5291.notablePrerequisites:
Cursed Mirror is a copy of Lightning Runner.
Your opponents can not block either Lightning Runner.
3073-4918-5291.description:
Attack with both Lightning Runners.
Both Lightning Runners trigger twice.
Resolve the first three triggers, adding {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}{E} and chosing not to pay the trigger.
Resolve the fourth trigger, adding {E}{E} and pay {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}{E}{E}{E} to untap all creatures you control, and after this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
Repeat.

24-1167-1927.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, gaining control of them during their next turn.
Move to their turn.
Cast Wheel of Misfortune for {2}{R}, selecting an arbitrarily large number for the opponent you control, and dealing that much damage to the opponent  if the oponent chose the largest number.
If the opponent didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to each opponent who chose the largest number.

3011-3231-4591.easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
3011-3231-4591.description:
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal lethal damage to each player with an even life total and nearly lethal damage to each opponent with an odd life total.
You cannot lose the game due to Platinum Angel.
